data.headline: Expertise & passion to transform businesses -  Revenue Driver | Strategy & Consulting | Cloud & Digital Transformation | Partnership & Alliances
data.about:
I excel when the waters are rough; champion at scaling revenue, driving organizational growth, transforming digital experience for global partners and building world-class cross-functional teams.

My extensive technical, sales & management background enables me as a leader to inspire global-virtual teams across geographies and cultural influences. I am a forward-thinker and through these 21 dynamic years of IT leadership, I have gained a competitive edge over business coupled with market knowledge to promote organizational growth and accelerate cloud & digital transformation for businesses.

Here is a snapshot for some of my career wins:
➡️ Yielded 15% cumulative annual growth and 33% business growth.
➡️ Sealed significant deals worth $100M+/deal and released revenue worth 85% of portfolio.
➡️ Piloted multimillion Cloud & AMS transformation deals for industry giants.
➡️ Designed $500M+ qualified pipeline in collaboration with key alliance partners.
➡️ Orchestrated cloud & digital transformation pipeline, ARR, go-lives & joint customer references.

I am a multi-domain taskmaster with expertise in Banking & Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Healthcare Business Verticals, Public, Hi-Tech & Telecom Business Sectors.
 
What makes me unique?
✅ Consultative sales with 17+ years of aggressive frontline sales
✅ Strategy innovation for world-class business results
✅ Mega enterprise digital transformation & winning enterprise app deals
✅ Complex cloud reinvigoration & application upgrade on Public, Private & Hybrid clouds 
✅ Best-in-class market strategy, industry solutions & services pipeline 
✅ Driving business incubation, new business acquisition & outperforming business goals  
✅ Triumphing grand commercial deals, service agreements, fostering alliance & partner relationships

I am open to meaningful conversations and exchanging ideas on business transformation, please feel free to connect with me on LinkedIn or write to me at vikrantsinghai@gmail.com

description.text:
I grew in roles and experience within Wipro from a GEO Ecosystem Lead to now a General Manager & Cluster Head and currently spearheading Europe & Africa for a significant Cloud implementation program. In my current role, I operate exclusive budgets, scale up business operations for the territory and have been instrumental in:

➡️ Leading Cloud, digital ecosystem & transformation revenue worth 85% of the portfolio and drive CXO-level decisive collaboration on sustainability & Net-Zero. 
➡️ Winning a vital multi-year utility deal worth for new payment architecture and multimillion Cloud transformation contract to promote technology experiments & new product development.

My career growth is a result of passion and exuberance to deliver exceptional business results in all the roles that I have performed until today. Here are the previous roles that I have championed at Wipro:

➡️ GM & Head of Sales | Digital & Modern Application Services | Technology, Energy, Utility, Construction, Natural Resources, Healthcare & Life Sciences | 2018 – 2020

➡️ Head of Strategic Deals & Integrated Services | Alliances & Analyst Relationships | 2017 – 2019

➡️ GEO Practice Head | GEO Ecosystem Lead | Quality Engineering & Oracle Ecosystem | 2016 – 2017

description.text: I integrated business solutions for Europe, Middle East & Africa which was then the fastest-growing service line, sealed multimillion worth deals with premier clients in the region, amplified practice & account level revenue targets and oversaw P&L across the QA accounts in the region.

I controlled engagement & service management for a large Investment bank (largest IVS account) across UK, Switzerland, US & Singapore, guided a team of 200+ QA members and executed the transition of 150+ associates into managed Services within the 3 lines of business (Risk IT area).

I joined Infosys as an Enterprise Quality Assurance Strategist for Independent Validation Services (IVS) and within a year got promoted as a Service Manager.

I kick-started my IT career with TCS P&O Nedlloyds account, which was one of the top 5 relationships for TCS at that point in time and from a trainee developer I performed and grew as an SME for Quality Engineering, Data & MIS for one of the largest IT program in the world.

I stirred engagement with NHS Trusts Information Directors & Information Managers to devise business and deployment plans for Cerner Millennium MIS solutions and monitored end-to-end delivery for a crucial deployment project plan.
